About Builds Your Mind

About Builds Your Mind

Purpose-driven educational kits that inspire learning while protecting our planet.

Our Story

Who We Are

Builds Your Mind is a purpose-driven educational kit brand focused on creating eco-friendly, engaging and practical learning solutions for students and learners of all ages.

All products are designed, manufactured and quality-tested by our parent company Harmono Pvt. Ltd., ensuring consistent quality, scalability and innovation in every educational kit we produce.

We believe that education should not come at the cost of our environment. That's why every product we create is designed with sustainability in mind, using recyclable materials and eco-friendly packaging.

How We Teach

Our Approach: Learning by Building

We believe students understand an idea best when they build it. Our workshops and kits are built around doing — assembling a circuit, testing a robot, fixing what did not work, and explaining why.

That is why our sessions are practical rather than theoretical, and why they are designed to be run with your own class groups.
